data.gender_notes: Altair is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who soars high or the one who is raised high. The name Altair carries the meaning “The Flyer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Altair usually hope their child will grow to embody the flyer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Altair belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Flyer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altair total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Altair, derived from the Arabic language, evokes images of soaring high and reaching great heights in various aspects of life. In astronomy, Altair is the twelfth brightest star in the night sky and the brightest star in the constellation Aquila, the Eagle. Named for its lofty position, the star's name has become synonymous with ambition, achievement, and success in various cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Altair represents the spiritual ascent towards God, or Allah. Altair signifies the idea of striving for greatness and transcendence through virtuous actions and deep spiritual connection. As the star's name encapsulates the notion of soaring high, individuals can find inspiration from it to aspire to reach the lofty heights of nearness to Allah and find inner peace and contentment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Flyer" symbolizes The one who soars high or the one who is raised high. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Altair serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the flyer.
